title: HB2124 (2019-2020 Regular): Exempting concealed pistol license holders from restrictions on possession of firearms in certain locations.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/2124.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version (HTML copy, marks visible). In Sec. 1 (3)(e) the bill strikes ', while picking up or dropping off a student', so license holders could possess a pistol on school grounds at any time. Quote (10) is joined from the marked lines {+:+}, {+(a) T+}, {+; or+}, {+(b)...+}; Sec. 3 (1) adds a lead-in 'Except as provided in subsection (3)' to the festival ban.

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.280): (3)(e) Any person in possession of a pistol who has been issued a license under RCW  9.41.070, or is exempt from the licensing requirement by RCW  9.41.060
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.280): (6) Except as provided in subsection (3)(b), (c), (e), (f), and (h) of this section, firearms are not permitted in a public or private school building.
Sec. 2 (RCW 9.41.300): (10) Subsection (1)(d) of this section does not apply to: (a) The proprietor of the premises or his or her employees while engaged in their employment; or (b) Any person in possession of a pistol who has been issued a license under RCW  9.41.070, or is exempt from the licensing requirement under RCW  9.41.060.
Sec. 3 (RCW 70.108.150): (3) This section does not apply to any person in possession of a pistol who has been issued a license under RCW  9.41.070, or is exempt from the licensing requirement under RCW  9.41.060.
